key_insight: CP-WSP is a declarative CP-SAT workforce scheduling framework that guarantees 14 hard constraints while optimizing 15 soft objectives through a JSON-configurable model.
engineering_relevance: It enables practical, regulation-safe scheduling for real operations by supporting breaks, acuity-weighted fairness, sub-shift granularity, schedule stability, and cross-midnight shifts without code changes.
method: Shift-window decomposition adds controllable mandatory break placement.
Unified weighted penalties optimize 15 soft objectives under 14 hard constraints.
JSON specifications configure multi-granularity, cross-midnight, and inter-week scheduling behavior.
evidence_signal: The framework was evaluated on INRC-II benchmarks at hourly and shift-level granularity, plus 36 synthetic configurations.
watch_item: Performance and solution quality may depend on the chosen weights and JSON settings, so careful tuning is needed to avoid unintended trade-offs.
paper_title: CP-WSP: A Declarative CP-SAT Framework for Configurable Multi-Constraint Workforce Scheduling
